product_metadata.title: Estilo Mini Countertop Trash Can | Brushed Stainless Steel, Swing Top Lid Trash Bin, Silver 1.5 L / 0.40 Gallon | Kitchen Countertop, Bedroom, Bathroom, Home Office, Desktop, Table Top Trash Can
features: SPACE-SAVING DESIGN - This countertop trash can takes up minimal space and fits perfectly on tabletops, countertops, desks, or kitchen tables - making it the ideal size for small apartments or offices.

SWING TOP LID - This mini trash bin is convenient to use with its swing top lid design, making it easy to throw small pieces of trash. It's perfect for small pieces of trash such as tissues, tea bags, food wrappers, cotton swabs, etc. Great to use in kitchens, offices, bathrooms and more!
HIGH QUALITY & DURABLE - This trash can is made of 100% brushed stainless steel, making it durable, rust-resistant, fingerprint resistant & stain proof. It’s very easy to clean and maintain.
MULTI-PURPOSE DESIGN - With an ample capacity, this trash can is ideal for both the kitchen and bathroom. Use it to store food waste, tissues, and more.
DIMENSIONS - 4.7" in diameter and 6.5" in height. Capacity: 1.5 L / 0.40 Gal
description: Say goodbye to messy and cluttered spaces, and say hello to this modern and stylish countertop trash can with lid. This mini trash can is the perfect solution for keeping your countertop, desk, or coffee bar tidy. It is made from durable stainless steel and has a lid for keeping contents contained. The countertop trash can is perfect for kitchen, bathroom, and bedroom. Its versatility and convenience make it the ideal choice for any home or office space. Plus, it will look great wherever you place it, and it will keep your space organized and mess-free. Get your countertop trash can today and make your space look chic, tidy, and organized.
